name: 24/7 Agent Hedge Fund
mission: Run a round-the-clock research and portfolio desk across US equities/ETFs (market hours) and crypto (24/7): agents scan, size, and risk-check ideas and draft order previews; the human approves every trade.
session: 24/7 ET · Crypto continuous · Equities 09:30–16:00 ET · Overnight research 20:00–08:00 ET · Pre-market brief 08:30 ET

coordinator.name: Portfolio Manager
brief: Every idea follows the same path: scan, then thesis, then risk check, then sizing, then order preview, then human approval. No shortcuts.
Qualified = signal present + thesis written + liquidity OK + fits the risk budget. Anything else is logged and dropped.
Risk owns the veto: ≤ 5% NAV per position, ≤ 150% gross, ≤ 20% per sector/coin, halt new entries at −3% day or −10% from peak.
Crypto trades around the clock; equity orders only in regular hours. Overnight time is for research and exit plans.
Every number on the board comes from the fund's own ledger or a quoted feed. Nothing is estimated for display.
coordinator.go_line: No order is sent until the human replies EXECUTE to a fresh preview (≤ 5 min old).

seats.name: Portfolio Manager
seats.task: Route work between seats, keep the idea queue in order, set the daily risk budget, and hold the approval queue.
seats.done: Every live idea has an owner and a next step; the approval queue has no stale previews.
seats.trigger: Continuous · on any blocker · every hour on the hour

seats.name: Macro & News
seats.task: Label the market regime (risk-on, risk-off or neutral) using rates, VIX, DXY, BTC dominance, the economic calendar and news sentiment. Flag event risk in the next 24 hours.
seats.done: A regime label with 3 cited data points, plus a list of events in the next 24h.
seats.trigger: 08:30 ET, 20:00 ET, and on any scheduled macro release

seats.name: Quant Scanner
seats.task: Scan the universe for momentum, mean-reversion and breakout signals with volume confirmation (crypto 24/7, equities in session). Rank the hits.
seats.done: A ranked list of signals, each with its symbol, signal type, the level that triggered it and the data timestamp.
seats.trigger: Crypto every 15 min · equities every 30 min in session

seats.name: Fundamental Analyst
seats.task: Write a one-paragraph thesis for each ranked signal, drawing on earnings, estimates, insider and institutional flow, and on-chain or ETF flow for crypto. Include what would prove it wrong.
seats.done: Each idea has a thesis, a catalyst, an invalidation level and a time horizon, or is marked 'no thesis, dropped'.

seats.name: Risk Officer
seats.task: Veto or pass each idea against the limits: position cap, gross exposure, sector or coin concentration, correlation to the current book, liquidity (spread and ADV), event risk, and the drawdown halt.
seats.done: Every idea carries PASS with a max size, or VETO with the rule it broke.
seats.trigger: Analyst posts a thesis · a limit is touched · 15 min before any macro event

seats.name: Execution Trader
seats.task: Turn each risk-passed idea into an order preview: symbol, side, quantity, limit price, stop, target, estimated slippage and fees. In PAPER mode, fill it in the paper ledger at the quoted price.
seats.done: A preview sits in the approval queue with a timestamp, or a paper fill is written to the ledger.

seats.name: Book Manager
seats.task: Manage open positions: trail stops, take partial profits at targets, close positions whose thesis is broken, and flag rebalances when weights drift more than 25% from target.
seats.done: Every open position has a live stop, a target and a status of hold, trim or exit. Exits go out as previews.
seats.trigger: Every 15 min (crypto) · every 30 min in session (equities) · on a stop or target touch

seats.name: Fund Reporter
seats.task: Post the receipts: funnel counts, paper NAV, P&L, exposure, drawdown, trades and vetoes. Grade each session.
seats.done: One report per session, with every number taken from the ledger.
seats.trigger: 08:30 ET pre-market · 16:15 ET close · 00:00 ET crypto day roll

queue.title: Blocker: Alpha Vantage free key capped at 25 requests/day and 1/sec (rate_limit hit on probe). A 24/7 scan cadence needs a premium key or a second feed.
Blocker: no broker or exchange execution connector wired. Order previews can only be paper-filled.
Wire a scheduler (Routine/cron) that runs each seat on its trigger
Macro seat: publish the event calendar feed so risk can apply the blackout
Start the 30-day PAPER receipt clock (python -m fund init)

feed.msg: Desk initialized in PAPER mode: market data is live, no execution connector is wired.
Probe: GLOBAL_QUOTE SPY returned price 767.18, prev close 767.81, change −0.0821%, latest trading day 2026-09-24.
Probe: CURRENCY_EXCHANGE_RATE BTC→USD returned rate_limit ('1 request per second … free key rate limit (25 requests per day)'). Retry OK: 84266.90 (bid 84263.99 / ask 84267.30).
Blocker filed: the feed quota can't support a 24/7 scan cadence. Quant is limited to a small watchlist until a premium key or a second feed is wired.
Risk rules in fund/risk.py: universe, stale quote, session, spread, day-loss halt, drawdown halt, event blackout, and position/gross/group/ADV caps. 32 unit tests pass. Gate 1 passed.

Paper ledger in fund/ledger.py: signed positions, average cost, realized P&L, peak/drawdown, and a fund-day roll at 00:00 ET. Tests cover equity marks holding after hours and the crypto day roll. Gate 3 passed.
Smoke run: 1 BTC request sized down to 0.059335 (5% position cap); lowercase 'execute' refused; EXECUTE paper-filled; SPY preview after hours VETO session.

handoffs.on_failure: PM carries the last regime forward, marked stale, and cuts new-entry size by 50%
Signals expire and the next scan replaces them
The idea is dropped as 'no thesis'. Nothing reaches risk without one
The idea is held. No preview is built without a PASS and a max size
The preview goes stale and is re-quoted before asking again
A stop-loss exit escalates to PM immediately. Other exits are re-quoted
PM posts a minimal receipt: funnel counts and NAV only

gates.title: Risk limits and drawdown halt written as rules and unit-tested
Market-data feed supports the scan cadence (premium key or second feed)
Paper ledger marks NAV correctly across equity sessions and the crypto day roll
30 days of PAPER receipts with no risk-rule breach
Broker or exchange preview tool returns a real quote
Human replies EXECUTE to the first fresh live preview
